exposure: Cause for PE diagnosis (gestational hypertension and FGR vs. primary organ dysfunction)
Presence of proteinuria or organ dysfunction during expectant management
outcome: Pregnancy prolongation from PE diagnosis to delivery
cohort: The study included 69 singleton pregnancy patients who developed preeclampsia (PE) before 34 weeks of gestation and were managed at a tertiary center between 2010 and 2016.
finding: Pregnancy prolongation from PE diagnosis to delivery was longer in patients diagnosed with PE due to gestational hypertension (GH) and FGR compared to those with primary organ dysfunction, suggesting organ dysfunction onset may reflect PE progression more accurately than FGR onset.
gest_age: Developed PE before 34 weeks of gestation
